fields.receipt_digest: sha256 over the canonical object without receipt_digest

transition_contract.verified: written only after Item and Slot remotely equal candidate_oid
transition_contract.rejection: pending may be deleted only after both expected refs are conclusively absent or unchanged
transition_contract.response_loss: preserve pending and requery; never blind-repeat the remote mutation

election.lock: exclusive sibling lock held across validation, atomic replacement and external-call election
election.write: same-directory temporary file, fsync, replace, parent-directory fsync
election.source_of_truth: remote control records; receipt grants local writer readiness only

provider_receipt.call_started_rule: exclusive exact-preimage transition persisted before provider mutation; response loss is requery-only

target_update_rule.intent: project-fence-v1 Target-Update-Intent and Attempt are durable before direct/provider target mutation
target_update_rule.reauthorization: only conclusive zero-target-effect permits a fresh Attempt
target_update_rule.ambiguous_or_partial: never blind-repeat; requery or manual incident

target_update_receipt.election: one process-shared exact-preimage prepared-to-call_started transition; crash after call_started is requery-only
